editorial:
Imagine a small town where love turns into a dangerous game. You have Pete, a nice guy who works with logs, and Molly, the girl he actually likes. Then there is Meg, who is totally obsessed with Pete and can't stand that he chose someone else. Instead of moving on, Meg comes up with a scary plan. She finds a guy named Humpy, who isn't very bright, and tricks him into doing her dirty work. It is a wild ride that shows how far some people will go when they are jealous and heartbroken.

Since this is a super old silent film, you will notice the acting is a bit over-the-top, but that is part of the charm. The plot moves quickly and keeps you guessing about whether Humpy will actually go through with the crime. If you enjoy old-school stories about betrayal, you should definitely check this out. You can find it as a digital rental on Apple TV, but if you really love movie history, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: The plan goes wrong when Humpy fails to get rid of Molly. Meg's manipulation eventually catches up with her, and her evil scheme is revealed to everyone. Instead of getting the man she wanted, she ends up losing everything. The movie ends with justice being served, showing that you cannot build a relationship on a foundation of lies and murder. It is a simple but clear lesson about karma and jealousy.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old silent movies and classic tales of betrayal.
